In March 2026, Valneva and Pfizer announced topline results from the Phase 3 “Vaccine Against Lyme for Outdoor Recreationists” (VALOR) trial (NCT05477524) investigating the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of LB6V in 9,437 participants five years of age and older.
The results of the completed Phase 1/2 study confirmed the interim data.
As discussed elsewhere in this report, Valneva and Pfizer announced topline results from the Phase 3 VALOR trial in March 2026.
